svg.text: The Epistle and the Missal transfer · LM-029A–LM-035A · spoken 1962 Low Mass, two servers

g.text: The Epistle read at the Epistle-side Missal
priest: standing · predella-epistle-corner · faces missal · eyes missal · on-missal
AC1: kneeling · step-1-epistle · faces altar · eyes altar · joined-before-breast
AC2: kneeling · step-1-gospel · faces altar · eyes altar · joined-before-breast
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
Deo gratias and the transfer cue
priest: standing · predella-epistle-corner · faces missal · eyes missal · on-missal
AC1: kneeling · step-1-epistle · faces altar · eyes altar · joined-before-breast
AC2: kneeling · step-1-gospel · faces altar · eyes altar · joined-before-breast
UNRESOLVED: The priest may signal the Missal transfer by placing his left hand on the altar, but
this cue is not universal; whether it is made, and at what moment, is a serving-profile
parameter the approved record deliberately left open. It is therefore not depicted as a fixed
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,

priest: standing · predella-epistle-corner · faces altar · eyes missal · joined-before-breast
AC1: standing · step-1-epistle · faces altar · eyes missal · joined-before-breast
AC2: kneeling · step-1-gospel · faces altar · eyes altar · joined-before-breast

AC1 lifts the open Missal on the Epistle side
priest: standing · predella-epistle-corner · faces altar · eyes altar · joined-before-breast
AC1: standing · step-3-epistle · faces altar · eyes missal · holding-missal
AC2: kneeling · step-1-gospel · faces altar · eyes altar · joined-before-breast
missal @ Held open in AC1's two hands, before his breast, at the Epistle side.
UNRESOLVED: Whether AC1 carries the Missal stand across with the open Missal, or the Gospel
corner of the altar is already furnished with its own stand, is a serving-profile parameter the
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,

missal @ Held open in AC1's two hands, before his breast, at the centre below the altar steps.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,

Munda cor meum said in a profound body bow
